caption: The video captures five people linked in a loose train on a vast, wet tidal flat under a bright blue sky. A small child leads a woman in yellow, a man in orange, a woman in red, and a man in blue, each holding the next person's hand or arm. The man in orange repeatedly extends an arm forward and points, while the others sway their connected arms and adjust their grip. The line shuffles slowly across the glossy mud, and their mirrored reflections stretch beneath them. As the group turns slightly, the man in blue shifts from the rear end into the middle of the chain, drawing the line into a more compact curve. The perspective changes from a front-quarter view toward a rear-quarter angle while the child remains at the left edge of the line. In the foreground, the tops of white and black umbrellas persist at the bottom edge, framing the procession on the reflective flat.
